captures.stdout:
Usage: ofs2rva <offset> FILE
Convert raw file offset to RVA

Example: ofs2rva 0x1b9b8 calc.exe

Options:
 -V, --version                          Show version.
 --help                                 Show this help.

OFS2RVA(1)                  General Commands Manual                 OFS2RVA(1)

NAME
       ofs2rva - converts a PE raw file offset to relative virtual address

SYNOPSIS
       ofs2rva offset pefile

DESCRIPTION
       ofs2rva  converts  a raw file offset to RVA (Relative Virtual Address),
       if it's valid. It's part of pev, the PE file analysis toolkit.

       offset is a valid PE file offset in decimal  or  hexadecimal  (prefixed
       with 0x).

       pefile is a PE32/PE32+ executable or dynamic linked library file.

OPTIONS
       -V, --version
              Show version.

       --help Show this help.

EXAMPLES
       Get RVA of 0x1b9b8 offset of calc.exe:

              $ ofs2rva 0x1b9b8 calc.exe

REPORTING BUGS
       Please,   check   the   latest   development   code   and   report   at
       https://github.com/mentebinaria/readpe/issues

SEE ALSO
       pedis(1),  pehash(1),   peldd(1),   pepack(1),   peres(1),   pescan(1),
       pesec(1), pestr(1), readpe(1), rva2ofs(1)
